decisions.reason: A reference class electrometer sits at the core of the firm's decades of dosimetry and accredited calibration expertise, so the firm can readily interpret market feedback and improve the product, and it is featured as a flagship on the home page.

Oncology risk management software is further from the firm's measurement core, but it builds on its software integration capabilities and its clinical physicist knowledge of patient safety, and it fits the strategy of converging machine and patient QA, so it is worth keeping and developing despite somewhat higher uncertainty.
